objective: Define the canonical logical domain/module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction and prohibited couplings for NEXUS QUANT before data, intelligence, risk/execution and runtime topology are detailed.
scope: Define external adapter and provider boundary
Define canonical instrument/reference-data and market-event boundary
Define allowed dependency direction and prohibited cross-domain access
Identify dedicated-process/service extraction candidates without implementing them
out_of_scope: Select runtime frameworks, databases, queues or cloud providers
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every domain has one primary owner
Dependency direction is explicit and acyclic at the logical-domain level
UX and agents cannot bypass application/domain APIs to mutate broker/provider state
Provider-specific data is confined to adapters/boundary metadata
Operations can observe/control health but cannot silently change trading risk policy
Country/location is absent from domain design
security_tests: Trading credentials remain withdrawal-disabled by principle
No provider SDK is allowed as a core domain dependency
evidence: P01 provider baseline and portability requirements
Domain boundary document and machine-readable matrix
rollback: Revert P02-B architecture artifacts and state/catalog changes. No runtime code or infrastructure is created.
definition_of_done: Service extraction candidates are documented without premature physical decomposition
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
